word: a slip of the tongue / pen

sentences.en: The CEO clarified that the incorrect revenue figure mentioned during the meeting was merely a slip of the tongue.
sentences.zh: 執行長澄清在會議中提到的錯誤營收數字純粹是口誤。

sentences.en: Due to a slip of the pen, the contract included an extra zero in the final payment amount.
sentences.zh: 因為筆誤，合約在最終付款金額上多寫了一個零。

sentences.en: She realized her comment was a slip of the tongue and immediately apologized to her colleagues.
sentences.zh: 她意識到自己的評論是口誤，立刻向同事們道歉。

sentences.en: A simple slip of the pen on the application form caused his visa processing to be delayed for weeks.
sentences.zh: 申請表上一個簡單的筆誤導致他的簽證處理被延誤了數週。

sentences.en: We must carefully proofread the press release to prevent any embarrassing slip of the pen.
sentences.zh: 我們必須仔細校對新聞稿，以避免任何令人尷尬的筆誤。

sentences.en: During her lunch break, she often sits on a park bench to read financial reports.
sentences.zh: 午休時間，她經常坐在公園長凳上閱讀財務報表。

sentences.en: The newly renovated corporate campus features several wooden benches for employees to relax on.
sentences.zh: 新翻修的企業園區設有幾張木製長凳供員工休息。

sentences.en: We waited on the bench outside the manager's office for our performance review.
sentences.zh: 我們在經理辦公室外面的長凳上等待績效考核。

sentences.en: The city council plans to install more benches along the business district's pedestrian walkways.
sentences.zh: 市議會計畫在商業區的行人步道旁安裝更多長凳。

sentences.en: He left his briefcase on the bench and had to run back to retrieve it before the train arrived.
sentences.zh: 他把公事包忘在長凳上了，只好在火車進站前跑回去拿。

sentences.en: The factory introduced new safety regulations to better protect its blue-collar workers.
sentences.zh: 工廠引進了新的安全法規，以更好地保護其藍領工人。

sentences.en: Many blue-collar jobs in the manufacturing sector are being transformed by automation.
sentences.zh: 製造業中的許多藍領工作正因自動化而轉型。

sentences.en: The union is negotiating for higher wages and better benefits for all blue-collar employees.
sentences.zh: 工會正在為所有藍領員工爭取更高的工資和更好的福利。

sentences.en: He started his career in a blue-collar position and eventually became the regional director.
sentences.zh: 他的職業生涯從藍領職位開始，最終成為了區域總監。

sentences.en: The government is offering retraining programs for blue-collar workers affected by the economic downturn.
sentences.zh: 政府正在為受經濟衰退影響的藍領勞工提供再培訓計畫。

sentences.en: The product specifications require the packaging to be exactly 15 centimeters in height.
sentences.zh: 產品規格要求包裝高度必須剛好是15公分。

sentences.en: Please ensure the margin on the document is at least two centimeters wide.
sentences.zh: 請確保文件的邊界至少有兩公分寬。

sentences.en: The water level in the reservoir has dropped by several centimeters due to the prolonged drought.
sentences.zh: 由於長期乾旱，水庫的水位已經下降了幾公分。

sentences.en: When ordering custom office furniture, every centimeter of available space must be measured accurately.
sentences.zh: 在訂購客製化辦公傢俱時，可用空間的每一公分都必須精確測量。

sentences.en: The new smartphone model is a few centimeters thinner than its predecessor.
sentences.zh: 新款智慧型手機比上一代薄了幾公分。

sentences.en: The dress code requires all male employees to wear shirts with a stiff collar and a tie.
sentences.zh: 服裝規定要求所有男性員工穿著硬領襯衫並打領帶。

sentences.en: She noticed a small coffee stain on the collar of her blouse right before the important presentation.
sentences.zh: 就在重要簡報前，她注意到自己女襯衫的衣領上有一小塊咖啡漬。

sentences.en: He nervously adjusted his collar while waiting to be interviewed by the hiring manager.
sentences.zh: 在等待人事經理面試時，他緊張地拉了拉衣領。

sentences.en: The dry cleaner guarantees to remove all sweat stains from the collars of your business shirts.
sentences.zh: 乾洗店保證能清除您商務襯衫衣領上的所有汗漬。

sentences.en: In casual Friday meetings, wearing an open collar without a tie is perfectly acceptable.
sentences.zh: 在星期五的休閒會議中，穿著開領不打領帶是完全可以接受的。

sentences.en: The department manager brought a box of doughnuts to celebrate the successful product launch.
sentences.zh: 部門經理帶了一盒甜甜圈來慶祝產品成功發表。

sentences.en: Sales of coffee and doughnuts usually peak during the morning rush hour.
sentences.zh: 咖啡和甜甜圈的銷售量通常在早晨尖峰時段達到高峰。

sentences.en: We had a quick breakfast of black coffee and a doughnut before heading to the seminar.
sentences.zh: 在前往研討會之前，我們吃了一頓黑咖啡配甜甜圈的快速早餐。

sentences.en: The bakery across the street supplies fresh doughnuts for our weekly staff meetings.
sentences.zh: 對街的麵包店為我們每週的員工會議供應新鮮甜甜圈。

sentences.en: He decided to cut back on eating doughnuts to maintain a healthier lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 他決定減少吃甜甜圈以維持更健康的生活方式。

sentences.en: Please erase all confidential files from the hard drive before returning the company laptop.
sentences.zh: 在歸還公司筆電之前，請消除硬碟中所有的機密檔案。

sentences.en: The accountant tried to erase the error on the ledger, but the auditor had already noticed it.
sentences.zh: 會計師試圖擦掉分類帳上的錯誤，但稽核員已經注意到了。

sentences.en: A successful marketing campaign can help erase the negative public image of a brand.
sentences.zh: 成功的行銷活動可以幫助消除品牌的負面公眾形象。

sentences.en: She quickly erased the notes on the whiteboard so the next team could use the meeting room.
sentences.zh: 她迅速擦掉白板上的筆記，以便下一個團隊可以使用會議室。

sentences.en: No matter how hard they tried, they could not completely erase the memory of the failed merger.
sentences.zh: 無論他們多麼努力，都無法完全消除那次合併失敗的記憶。

meaning: 昂貴的、豪華的；花俏精緻的、酷炫的；幻想；喜歡 (男女之間的)

sentences.en: The executives hosted a dinner at a fancy restaurant to impress their potential clients.
sentences.zh: 高階主管們在一家豪華餐廳舉辦晚宴，以給潛在客戶留下深刻印象。

sentences.en: We don't need any fancy software; a basic spreadsheet program will suffice for this project.
sentences.zh: 我們不需要任何酷炫花俏的軟體；一個基本的試算表程式就足以應付這個專案。

sentences.en: The marketing team stayed at a fancy hotel in downtown Tokyo during the exhibition week.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊在展覽週期間住在東京市中心的一家高級飯店。

sentences.en: He took a fancy to the new intern, but company policy prohibits office romances.
sentences.zh: 他喜歡上了新來的實習生，但公司規定禁止辦公室戀情。

sentences.en: It is mere fancy to expect our sales to double without increasing the advertising budget.
sentences.zh: 期望在不增加廣告預算的情況下讓我們的銷售額翻倍，純屬幻想。

sentences.en: Investors flocked to buy shares of the tech company immediately after its initial public offering.
sentences.zh: 這家科技公司首次公開發行後，投資者成群結隊地搶購其股票。

sentences.en: During the holiday season, shoppers flock to the mall looking for the best discounts.
sentences.zh: 在節慶期間，購物者蜂擁至購物中心尋找最好的折扣。

sentences.en: A large flock of birds caused the outbound flight to be delayed for safety inspections.
sentences.zh: 一大群鳥導致出境航班為了安全檢查而延誤。

sentences.en: Tourists flock to this coastal city every summer, boosting the local hospitality industry.
sentences.zh: 每年夏天遊客成群結隊來到這座沿海城市，促進了當地的飯店業。

sentences.en: Customers have been flocking to our new flagship store since the grand opening last weekend.
sentences.zh: 自從上週末盛大開幕以來，顧客們一直湧入我們的新旗艦店。

sentences.en: The local grocer has built a loyal customer base by offering fresh, organic produce.
sentences.zh: 當地的雜貨商透過提供新鮮的有機農產品建立了一群忠實的顧客。

sentences.en: Independent grocers are finding it increasingly difficult to compete with large supermarket chains.
sentences.zh: 獨立雜貨商發現越來越難以與大型連鎖超市競爭。

sentences.en: The grocer assured us that the imported cheese would be delivered by tomorrow afternoon.
sentences.zh: 雜貨商向我們保證，進口乳酪將在明天下午前送達。

sentences.en: After retiring from the corporate world, he decided to open a small shop and become a grocer.
sentences.zh: 從企業界退休後，他決定開一家小店，當個雜貨商。

sentences.en: The neighborhood grocer always remembers his regular customers' preferences.
sentences.zh: 社區的雜貨商總是記得他常客的偏好。

sentences.en: Our weekly grocery bill has increased significantly due to the recent inflation.
sentences.zh: 由於近期的通貨膨脹，我們每週的雜貨開銷大幅增加。

sentences.en: She ordered all her grocery items online to save time after a busy day at work.
sentences.zh: 經過一天忙碌的工作後，她在網路上訂購了所有雜貨以節省時間。

sentences.en: The delivery service ensures that your grocery items arrive fresh and neatly packaged.
sentences.zh: 這項外送服務確保您的雜貨新鮮且包裝整齊地送達。

sentences.en: I need to pick up some grocery essentials on my way home from the office.
sentences.zh: 我下班回家的路上需要買一些日常雜貨。

sentences.en: A significant portion of their household budget is allocated to grocery shopping.
sentences.zh: 他們家庭預算的很大一部分分配給了購買雜貨。

sentences.en: The new grocery store in our neighborhood features a wide selection of imported goods.
sentences.zh: 我們社區新開的雜貨店提供多樣化的進口商品選擇。

sentences.en: He works part-time at a local grocery store to help pay for his college tuition.
sentences.zh: 他在當地的一家雜貨店兼職打工，以幫助支付大學學費。

sentences.en: Many grocery stores have implemented self-checkout lanes to speed up the payment process.
sentences.zh: 許多雜貨店已經實施了自助結帳通道，以加快付款流程。

sentences.en: The grocery store chain announced a merger to expand its presence across the region.
sentences.zh: 這家雜貨店連鎖企業宣布合併，以擴大其在該地區的版圖。

sentences.en: She forgot her shopping list and had to guess what she needed at the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 她忘了帶購物清單，只好在雜貨店裡猜測自己需要什麼。

meaning: 體育館；健身房；體育、體操（在體育館內進行的體育活動）

sentences.en: The company's new wellness center includes a fully equipped gymnasium for employees.
sentences.zh: 公司新建的健康中心包含一間供員工使用的設備齊全的健身房。

sentences.en: The annual shareholders' meeting will be held in the local university's gymnasium due to the large expected turnout.
sentences.zh: 由於預計出席人數眾多，年度股東大會將在當地大學的體育館舉行。

sentences.en: After a stressful day at the office, he likes to work out in the gymnasium to unwind.
sentences.zh: 在辦公室度過壓力大的一天後，他喜歡在健身房運動來放鬆身心。

sentences.en: The school is raising funds to renovate its old gymnasium and purchase new sports equipment.
sentences.zh: 學校正在籌集資金翻新舊體育館並購買新的運動器材。

sentences.en: A membership at this exclusive gymnasium grants you access to premium fitness classes and personal trainers.
sentences.zh: 擁有這家專屬健身房的會員資格，您可以參加高級健身課程並獲得私人教練指導。

sentences.en: The experienced supervisor took pity on the struggling intern and offered to mentor him.
sentences.zh: 經驗豐富的主管同情這位苦苦掙扎的實習生，並主動提出要指導他。

sentences.en: She had pity on the homeless man sitting outside the office and bought him a warm meal.
sentences.zh: 她同情坐在辦公室外的無家可歸男子，並買了一份熱餐給他。

sentences.en: The judge took pity on the young offender and sentenced him to community service instead of jail time.
sentences.zh: 法官同情這名年輕的罪犯，判處他社區服務以代替坐牢。

sentences.en: They took pity on the stranded passengers and allowed them to wait in the VIP lounge.
sentences.zh: 他們同情滯留的乘客，並允許他們在貴賓休息室等候。

sentences.en: Please have pity on me and give me a slight extension on this project deadline.
sentences.zh: 請同情我，並讓這個專案的截止日期稍微延後一點吧。

meaning: 頭部、指揮官、領導者；朝~方向前進；領導、帶頭

sentences.en: The head of the marketing department is responsible for approving the annual advertising budget.
sentences.zh: 行銷部主管負責批准年度廣告預算。

sentences.en: After the conference concludes, we will head directly to the airport for our return flight.
sentences.zh: 會議結束後，我們將直接前往機場搭乘回程航班。

sentences.en: The CEO was chosen to head the new task force focused on sustainable business practices.
sentences.zh: 執行長被選來領導專注於永續商業實踐的新任務小組。

sentences.en: Make sure to protect your head by wearing a hard hat when entering the construction site.
sentences.zh: 進入建築工地時，務必戴上安全帽以保護頭部。

sentences.en: We are currently heading into a period of significant economic uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 我們目前正朝著一段經濟極度不確定的時期前進。

sentences.en: Please organize the financial report clearly and use bold text for each main heading.
sentences.zh: 請將財務報告整理清楚，並將每個主要標題使用粗體字。

sentences.en: Under the heading 'Future Projections', you will find our estimated sales figures for the next quarter.
sentences.zh: 在「未來預測」這個標題下，您會找到我們下個季度的預估銷售數據。

sentences.en: The document lacks proper headings, making it difficult for the readers to navigate the content.
sentences.zh: 這份文件缺乏適當的標題，使得讀者難以瀏覽內容。

sentences.en: She added a new heading in the manual to specifically address the troubleshooting procedures.
sentences.zh: 她在手冊中增加了一個新標題，專門說明故障排除程序。

sentences.en: All expense claims must be submitted under the appropriate department heading on the form.
sentences.zh: 所有費用報銷都必須在表格上適當的部門標題下提交。

sentences.en: The scandal involving the CEO made the front-page headline of every major financial newspaper.
sentences.zh: 涉及執行長的醜聞登上了每一家主要財經報紙的頭版頭條。

sentences.en: Our PR team is working hard to ensure the product launch catches tomorrow's news headlines.
sentences.zh: 我們的公關團隊正努力確保產品發表能登上明天的報紙頭條。

sentences.en: A catchy headline is crucial for attracting readers to our company's blog posts.
sentences.zh: 一個吸引人的頭條對於吸引讀者閱讀我們公司的部落格文章至關重要。

sentences.en: The sudden stock market crash dominated the news headlines throughout the entire week.
sentences.zh: 突如其來的股市崩盤占據了整整一週的新聞頭條。

sentences.en: He quickly scanned the morning headlines before starting his first meeting of the day.
sentences.zh: 他在開始當天第一個會議之前，快速瀏覽了早報的頭條。

sentences.en: The safety inspector reminded all factory workers that wearing a helmet on the floor is mandatory.
sentences.zh: 安全檢查員提醒所有工廠工人，在廠區內戴安全帽是強制規定。

sentences.en: He rides his bicycle to the office every day and always remembers to strap on his helmet.
sentences.zh: 他每天騎腳踏車去辦公室，而且總是記得扣好安全帽。

sentences.en: The construction company ordered a new batch of yellow helmets for the upcoming project.
sentences.zh: 這家建築公司為了即將到來的專案訂購了一批新的黃色頭盔。

sentences.en: Failure to wear a protective helmet in the designated area will result in a severe warning.
sentences.zh: 在指定區域未戴防護頭盔將會受到嚴厲的警告。

sentences.en: The delivery driver took off his helmet before entering the lobby to drop off the packages.
sentences.zh: 送貨司機在進入大廳放下包裹前脫下了他的安全帽。

sentences.en: During his first overseas assignment, he felt intensely homesick and often called his family.
sentences.zh: 在他第一次被派駐海外期間，他感到非常想家，並經常打電話給家人。

sentences.en: The company provides support groups for expatriates who might be feeling isolated or homesick.
sentences.zh: 公司為可能感到孤立或思鄉的外派人員提供互助小組。

sentences.en: She misses the authentic street food of her country whenever she gets homesick.
sentences.zh: 每當她想家的時候，她就會想念她國家的道地街頭美食。

sentences.en: Being surrounded by colleagues from her own culture helped her feel less homesick in the foreign office.
sentences.zh: 在國外分公司，身邊圍繞著來自相同文化的同事，幫助她減輕了思鄉之情。

sentences.en: Although he was excited about the promotion in London, he couldn't help but feel a little homesick.
sentences.zh: 雖然他對在倫敦的升職感到興奮，但還是忍不住感到有些想家。

sentences.en: After successfully expanding his business globally, he opened a charity foundation in his hometown.
sentences.zh: 在全球成功拓展業務後，他在自己的故鄉成立了一個慈善基金會。

sentences.en: She usually uses all her annual leave to visit her hometown during the Lunar New Year.
sentences.zh: 她通常會用光所有的特休，在農曆新年期間回故鄉探親。

sentences.en: The new branch manager is highly respected because he is a well-known figure in this hometown.
sentences.zh: 新任分行經理備受尊敬，因為他是這個故鄉的知名人物。

sentences.en: Our company actively recruits talents from local universities near our founders' hometown.
sentences.zh: 我們公司積極從創辦人故鄉附近的當地大學招募人才。

sentences.en: He often reminisces about his childhood and the slow-paced life in his quiet hometown.
sentences.zh: 他經常回憶起他的童年，以及在他寧靜故鄉的慢節奏生活。

sentences.en: Due to the heavy rain, the corporate team-building event was moved to an indoor facility.
sentences.zh: 由於下大雨，企業團隊建立活動被移至室內場地舉行。

sentences.en: Our building features an indoor parking lot, ensuring employees' cars are protected from the weather.
sentences.zh: 我們的大樓設有室內停車場，確保員工的汽車免受天氣影響。

sentences.en: The shopping center boasts a massive indoor amusement park to attract families on weekends.
sentences.zh: 這家購物中心擁有一座巨大的室內遊樂園，以在週末吸引家庭客群。

sentences.en: We need to install better indoor lighting to improve the working environment in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 我們需要安裝更好的室內照明，以改善倉庫的工作環境。

sentences.en: The agricultural startup specializes in vertical indoor farming using advanced hydroponic systems.
sentences.zh: 這家農業新創公司專精於使用先進水耕系統的垂直室內農業。

sentences.en: Because of the severe air pollution alert, employees are advised to stay indoors during their lunch break.
sentences.zh: 因為嚴重的空氣汙染警報，建議員工在午休時間留在室內。

sentences.en: The construction crew had to pause their work and wait indoors until the thunderstorm passed.
sentences.zh: 建築工人們不得不暫停工作，在室內等待直到雷暴過去。

sentences.en: All company-sponsored recreational activities will be held indoors this winter.
sentences.zh: 今年冬天所有公司贊助的休閒活動都將在室內舉行。

sentences.en: Please ensure that the exhibition booths are completely set up indoors before the clients arrive.
sentences.zh: 請確保在客戶到達之前，展覽攤位已完全在室內布置完畢。

sentences.en: She prefers to work out indoors rather than jogging outside in the freezing weather.
sentences.zh: 她寧願在室內運動，也不願在酷寒的天氣裡到戶外慢跑。

sentences.en: He was secretly jealous when his colleague received the promotion they both had applied for.
sentences.zh: 當他的同事獲得他們兩人共同申請的晉升機會時，他暗自感到嫉妒。

sentences.en: The competitor was jealous of our company's sudden surge in market share and rapid growth.
sentences.zh: 競爭對手對我們公司市占率的突然飆升和快速成長感到嫉妒。

sentences.en: A healthy work environment shouldn't foster jealous behaviors among team members.
sentences.zh: 一個健康的工作環境不應助長團隊成員間的嫉妒行為。

sentences.en: She felt slightly jealous of her manager's spacious corner office with a fantastic city view.
sentences.zh: 她對經理擁有絕佳城市景觀的寬敞角落辦公室感到有些嫉妒。

sentences.en: Jealous disputes over client accounts can seriously damage the productivity of the sales department.
sentences.zh: 因客戶帳戶而產生的嫉妒糾紛可能會嚴重損害業務部的生產力。

sentences.en: The hotel breakfast buffet features a variety of breads served with butter and fruit jelly.
sentences.zh: 飯店的自助早餐提供多種麵包，搭配奶油和水果果醬。

sentences.en: We decided to launch a new line of organic grape jelly targeting health-conscious consumers.
sentences.zh: 我們決定推出一系列針對注重健康消費者的有機葡萄果醬。

sentences.en: The packaging for the strawberry jelly jars needs to be redesigned before the upcoming trade show.
sentences.zh: 草莓果醬罐的包裝必須在即將到來的貿易展前重新設計。

sentences.en: As a quick snack during the break, she had some crackers spread with peanut butter and jelly.
sentences.zh: 休息時間當作快速的零食，她吃了一些塗有花生醬和果醬的餅乾。

sentences.en: The food processing plant ensures strict quality control when manufacturing their famous apple jelly.
sentences.zh: 這家食品加工廠在製造其著名的蘋果果醬時，確保嚴格的品質控管。

sentences.en: The antique ring, featuring a rare blue jewel, was sold at the auction for a record price.
sentences.zh: 那枚鑲有一顆稀有藍色寶石的古董戒指，在拍賣會上以創紀錄的價格售出。

sentences.en: The museum hired extra security guards to protect the crown jewels during the special exhibition.
sentences.zh: 博物館聘請了額外的保全人員，以在特別展覽期間保護皇室珠寶。

sentences.en: She found a loose jewel in the velvet box and took it to the jeweler for repair.
sentences.zh: 她在天鵝絨盒子裡找到一顆鬆落的寶石，並把它送到珠寶匠那裡修理。

sentences.en: This historic building is widely considered the architectural jewel of the downtown business district.
sentences.zh: 這棟歷史建築被廣泛認為是市中心商業區的建築瑰寶。

sentences.en: He bought a beautiful jewel as an anniversary gift for his wife after closing a major deal.
sentences.zh: 在談成一筆大生意後，他買了一顆美麗的寶石作為送給妻子的週年紀念禮物。

sentences.en: The luxury brand is planning to expand its product line to include high-end designer jewelry.
sentences.zh: 這個奢侈品牌正計畫將其產品線擴展至包含高檔設計師珠寶。

sentences.en: She works as a sales consultant in a prestigious jewelry store located in the high street mall.
sentences.zh: 她在位於商業大街購物中心的一家著名珠寶店擔任銷售顧問。

sentences.en: When traveling internationally for business, it is advisable not to wear expensive jewelry.
sentences.zh: 在進行國際商務旅行時，建議不要配戴昂貴的珠寶。

sentences.en: The thief managed to bypass the security system and steal thousands of dollars' worth of jewelry.
sentences.zh: 小偷設法繞過了保全系統，偷走了價值數千美元的珠寶。

sentences.en: Our insurance policy covers theft and damage for all office electronics and personal jewelry on site.
sentences.zh: 我們的保險單涵蓋了現場所有辦公電子產品和個人珠寶的失竊和損壞。

sentences.en: We need to clear out all the old junk from the storage room to make space for the new server racks.
sentences.zh: 我們需要清除儲藏室裡所有沒用的舊東西，騰出空間來放置新的伺服器機架。

sentences.en: The IT department installed a new filter to prevent junk email from reaching employees' inboxes.
sentences.zh: 資訊部門安裝了新的過濾器，以防止垃圾郵件進入員工的收件匣。

sentences.en: Most of the documents in this archived box are just outdated junk that should be shredded.
sentences.zh: 這個存檔箱裡的大多數文件都只是應該被碎紙機處理掉的過時廢物。

sentences.en: He sold his old, broken-down car to a scrapyard because it was nothing more than a piece of junk.
sentences.zh: 他把他那輛破舊拋錨的車賣給了廢車場，因為它簡直就是一塊廢鐵。

sentences.en: Please do not clutter your office desk with unnecessary junk and keep the workspace tidy.
sentences.zh: 請不要用不必要的雜物弄亂您的辦公桌，並保持工作空間整潔。

sentences.en: To promote employee health, the company replaced the junk food in the vending machines with fresh fruit and nuts.
sentences.zh: 為了促進員工健康，公司將自動販賣機裡的垃圾食品替換為新鮮水果和堅果。

sentences.en: Consuming too much junk food during late-night shifts can negatively affect your overall productivity.
sentences.zh: 在深夜輪班期間食用過多的垃圾食品，可能會對您的整體生產力產生負面影響。

sentences.en: The government is considering implementing an additional tax on junk food to combat the rising obesity rates.
sentences.zh: 政府正考慮對垃圾食品徵收額外稅款，以對抗不斷上升的肥胖率。

sentences.en: He promised his doctor that he would cut out junk food and start a proper diet immediately.
sentences.zh: 他向醫生保證他會戒掉垃圾食品，並立刻開始適當的飲食。

sentences.en: Many fast-food chains are trying to alter their menus to distance themselves from the junk food label.
sentences.zh: 許多速食連鎖店正試圖改變他們的菜單，以擺脫垃圾食品的標籤。

sentences.en: The executive took an extended medical leave due to complications with a severe kidney infection.
sentences.zh: 這位高階主管因嚴重的腎臟感染併發症而休了延長病假。

sentences.en: Drinking plenty of water during the workday is essential for maintaining healthy kidney function.
sentences.zh: 在工作日多喝水對於維持健康的腎臟功能至關重要。

sentences.en: The company's health insurance plan covers a wide range of treatments, including kidney dialysis.
sentences.zh: 公司的健康保險計畫涵蓋了廣泛的治療，包括腎臟透析（洗腎）。

sentences.en: He successfully underwent a kidney transplant operation and is currently recovering in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他成功進行了腎臟移植手術，目前正在醫院康復中。

sentences.en: The pharmaceutical company is developing a new medication designed specifically to treat kidney stones.
sentences.zh: 這家製藥公司正在開發一種專門用於治療腎結石的新藥。

sentences.en: The new logistics center is located approximately 15 kilometers away from the main international port.
sentences.zh: 新的物流中心距離主要國際港口大約15公里。

sentences.en: Sales representatives are allowed to claim travel expenses at a fixed rate per kilometer driven.
sentences.zh: 業務代表可以按照駕駛的公里數，以固定費率報銷交通費。

sentences.en: The marathon route covers a distance of exactly 42.195 kilometers through the city center.
sentences.zh: 馬拉松路線涵蓋了穿過市中心整整42.195公里的距離。

sentences.en: Traffic on the highway is backed up for several kilometers due to a multi-vehicle collision.
sentences.zh: 由於多車相撞，高速公路上的交通回堵了幾公里。

sentences.en: We will have to construct a fiber-optic cable network spanning over 100 kilometers for this project.
sentences.zh: 為了這個專案，我們必須建設一個橫跨超過100公里的光纖電纜網路。

sentences.en: Make sure to tie a tight knot to secure the cargo before the truck leaves the loading dock.
sentences.zh: 在卡車駛離裝卸碼頭之前，請務必打個緊結以固定貨物。

sentences.en: His stomach was tied in knots as he prepared to deliver his presentation to the board of directors.
sentences.zh: 當他準備向董事會發表演說時，他緊張得胃都揪結在一起了。

sentences.en: The maritime shipping contract specifies speed limits measured in knots for all commercial vessels.
sentences.zh: 海運合約規定了所有商用船隻以節為單位的速度限制。

sentences.en: She successfully untangled the complicated knot in the networking cable.
sentences.zh: 她成功解開了網路線上複雜的結。

sentences.en: To create a professional appearance, he carefully tied a perfect Windsor knot for his necktie.
sentences.zh: 為了展現專業形象，他小心翼翼地為領帶打了一個完美的溫莎結。

meaning: 隨手丟棄的垃圾；隨手亂丟垃圾

sentences.en: The facility manager posted signs reminding employees not to litter in the outdoor smoking area.
sentences.zh: 設施經理張貼了標語，提醒員工不要在戶外吸菸區亂丟垃圾。

sentences.en: The city implemented strict fines for individuals caught dropping litter on public streets.
sentences.zh: 市政府對在公共街道上被抓到亂丟垃圾的個人實施嚴格罰款。

sentences.en: As part of the corporate social responsibility program, our team volunteered to clean up litter on the local beach.
sentences.zh: 作為企業社會責任計畫的一部分，我們團隊自願清理當地海灘上的垃圾。

sentences.en: Please use the provided recycling bins and ensure no litter is left behind in the conference hall.
sentences.zh: 請使用提供的資源回收桶，並確保會議廳內沒有留下任何垃圾。

sentences.en: Littering is strictly prohibited in the national park to protect the sensitive wildlife habitat.
sentences.zh: 為了保護敏感的野生動物棲息地，國家公園內嚴禁亂丟垃圾。

sentences.en: Excessive alcohol consumption at corporate networking events can severely damage your liver over time.
sentences.zh: 在企業社交活動中過度飲酒，久而久之會嚴重損害您的肝臟。

sentences.en: The medical researchers announced a breakthrough in treating chronic liver diseases.
sentences.zh: 醫學研究人員宣布在治療慢性肝病方面取得了突破。

sentences.en: During his annual health checkup, the doctor advised him to adopt a diet that is better for his liver.
sentences.zh: 在年度健康檢查中，醫生建議他採取對肝臟更好的飲食。

sentences.en: The patient is currently on the waiting list for a liver transplant operation.
sentences.zh: 該名患者目前正在等待肝臟移植手術的名單上。

sentences.en: The laboratory tests revealed abnormal liver function, prompting further medical investigations.
sentences.zh: 實驗室檢驗顯示肝功能異常，促使進一步的醫學檢查。

sentences.en: The factory installed an advanced ventilation system to protect workers from inhaling harmful dust into their lungs.
sentences.zh: 工廠安裝了先進的通風系統，以保護工人免於將有害粉塵吸入肺部。

sentences.en: Years of smoking had significantly reduced his lung capacity, making physical tasks exhausting.
sentences.zh: 多年的吸菸大大降低了他的肺活量，使得體力勞動變得令人筋疲力盡。

sentences.en: The hospital is seeking funding to purchase a state-of-the-art scanner for early lung cancer detection.
sentences.zh: 這家醫院正在尋求資金購買一台最先進的掃描儀，用於早期肺癌檢測。

sentences.en: Air quality regulations are strict in this industrial zone to minimize the risk of lung diseases among residents.
sentences.zh: 這個工業區的空氣品質規定很嚴格，以盡可能降低居民罹患肺部疾病的風險。

sentences.en: He took a deep breath, filling his lungs with fresh air before walking into the stressful board meeting.
sentences.zh: 在走進壓力沉重的董事會會議之前，他深吸了一口氣，讓肺部充滿新鮮空氣。

sentences.en: Our retail company plans to open three new boutique stores in the suburban shopping mall next year.
sentences.zh: 我們的零售公司計畫明年在郊區的購物中心開設三家新的精品店。

sentences.en: The newly constructed mall features an extensive food court and a multi-screen cinema complex.
sentences.zh: 新建成的購物中心設有一個廣闊的美食廣場和一個多廳電影院複合設施。

sentences.en: Foot traffic in the mall increases exponentially during the holiday shopping season.
sentences.zh: 在節慶購物季期間，購物中心的人潮呈指數級成長。

sentences.en: We arranged to meet our clients for a casual lunch at a restaurant inside the mall.
sentences.zh: 我們安排了在購物中心內的一家餐廳與客戶共進輕鬆的午餐。

sentences.en: The property management firm is currently negotiating lease agreements with several major anchor tenants for the mall.
sentences.zh: 物業管理公司目前正與該購物中心的幾家主要主力租戶協商租賃合約。

sentences.en: The CEO described the team's quarterly performance as marvelous and approved the bonus distribution.
sentences.zh: 執行長將團隊的季度表現形容為令人驚嘆的，並批准了獎金發放。

sentences.en: We had a marvelous time at the annual company retreat in Hawaii.
sentences.zh: 我們在夏威夷的年度公司員工旅遊中度過了美好的時光。

sentences.en: It would be marvelous if we could secure this contract before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 如果我們能在月底前拿下這份合約，那真是太棒了。

sentences.en: She has been doing a marvelous job in managing the new marketing campaign.
sentences.zh: 她在管理新的行銷活動方面表現得非常出色。

sentences.en: The new software update introduced some marvelous features that improved our workflow significantly.
sentences.zh: 新的軟體更新引入了一些令人驚嘆的功能，顯著改善了我們的工作流程。

sentences.en: The company awarded a gold medal to the employee of the year during the gala.
sentences.zh: 公司在晚會上頒發了一面金牌給年度最佳員工。

sentences.en: He proudly displayed the marathon finisher's medal on his office desk.
sentences.zh: 他驕傲地將馬拉松完賽獎牌展示在他的辦公桌上。

sentences.en: Having won several medals in international competitions, she is highly respected in her field.
sentences.zh: 在國際比賽中贏得數面獎牌後，她在她的領域備受尊敬。

sentences.en: The sales team is striving to earn the top medal for outstanding performance this quarter.
sentences.zh: 業務團隊正努力爭取本季度傑出表現的最高獎牌。

sentences.en: Will they be presenting the medals right after the final event?
sentences.zh: 他們會在決賽結束後立刻頒發獎牌嗎？

sentences.en: The manager wished everyone a merry Christmas and a prosperous New Year before the holiday break.
sentences.zh: 經理在假期前祝大家聖誕歡樂、新年繁榮。

sentences.en: A merry atmosphere filled the office as the team celebrated their successful product launch.
sentences.zh: 當團隊慶祝產品成功發表時，辦公室裡充滿了歡樂的氣氛。

sentences.en: They were making merry at the local pub after closing a huge deal with the overseas client.
sentences.zh: 在與海外客戶完成一筆大交易後，他們在當地的酒吧裡盡情狂歡。

sentences.en: Despite the tight deadline, the staff remained merry and cooperative.
sentences.zh: 儘管期限緊迫，員工們依然保持歡樂和合作。

sentences.en: We enjoyed a merry evening of networking and dining with our business partners.
sentences.zh: 我們與商業夥伴共度了一個歡樂的交流與晚宴之夜。

sentences.en: The amusement park's classic merry-go-round is currently under maintenance and will reopen next week.
sentences.zh: 遊樂園經典的旋轉木馬目前正在維修，將於下週重新開放。

sentences.en: The children laughed joyfully as they rode the brightly painted horses on the merry-go-round.
sentences.zh: 孩子們騎在旋轉木馬上色彩鮮豔的馬匹時，開心地笑著。

sentences.en: Sometimes, corporate life feels like an endless merry-go-round of meetings and emails.
sentences.zh: 有時候，企業生活感覺就像是開會和收發電子郵件的無止境旋轉木馬。

sentences.en: We need to step off this merry-go-round of indecision and make a final choice for the project.
sentences.zh: 我們需要跳出這個猶豫不決的旋轉木馬，為專案做出最終決定。

sentences.en: The city council approved the budget to install a new merry-go-round in the central plaza.
sentences.zh: 市議會批准了在中央廣場安裝新旋轉木馬的預算。

sentences.en: The taxi driver turned on the meter as soon as the client got into the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 客戶一上車，計程車司機就開啟了計費表。

sentences.en: The factory is located about five hundred meters away from the main train station.
sentences.zh: 這間工廠距離中央火車站大約五百公尺。

sentences.en: Please ensure that the parking meter is fed so we don't get a fine during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 請確保停車計費錶有投幣，這樣我們在開會時才不會被罰款。

sentences.en: We are currently reading the electricity meter to calculate this month's utility expenses.
sentences.zh: 我們目前正在讀取電錶以計算本月的水電開銷。

sentences.en: The new fabric must be ordered by the meter for the upcoming fashion exhibition.
sentences.zh: 為即將到來的時尚展覽，新布料必須以公尺為單位訂購。

sentences.en: Please make sure the microphone is turned on before you begin your presentation to the board.
sentences.zh: 在開始向董事會簡報之前，請確保麥克風已經開啟。

sentences.en: The technician is adjusting the mike to eliminate the background noise during the conference call.
sentences.zh: 技術人員正在調整麥克風，以消除電話會議期間的背景噪音。

sentences.en: She leaned into the microphone to answer the reporter's question clearly.
sentences.zh: 她靠近麥克風，以便清楚地回答記者的問題。

sentences.en: Can you pass the mike to the next speaker in the audience?
sentences.zh: 你能把麥克風傳給觀眾席上的下一位發言者嗎？

sentences.en: We have ordered wireless microphones for the upcoming seminar to allow speakers more mobility.
sentences.zh: 我們為即將舉行的研討會訂購了無線麥克風，以讓講者有更多行動空間。

sentences.en: Employees are reminded to keep the office microwave clean after heating up their lunches.
sentences.zh: 提醒員工在加熱午餐後保持辦公室微波爐的清潔。

sentences.en: The new smart microwave can be controlled via an app on your smartphone.
sentences.zh: 這款新型智慧微波爐可以透過智慧型手機上的應用程式控制。

sentences.en: I just microwaved some leftovers for dinner since I had to work overtime.
sentences.zh: 因為必須加班，我晚餐只微波了一些剩菜。

sentences.en: Please do not put any metal containers inside the microwave, as it poses a serious safety hazard.
sentences.zh: 請不要將任何金屬容器放入微波爐中，因為這會造成嚴重的安全隱患。

sentences.en: Our company produces a wide range of kitchen appliances, including highly efficient microwaves.
sentences.zh: 我們公司生產各式各樣的廚房電器，包含高效能微波爐。

sentences.en: Taking a short nap after lunch can significantly boost your productivity for the rest of the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 午餐後小睡片刻可以顯著提升你整個下午的生產力。

sentences.en: The CEO often takes a 20-minute nap in his private office to recharge before important negotiations.
sentences.zh: 執行長經常在私人辦公室裡小睡 20 分鐘，以便在重要談判前補充體力。

sentences.en: The new wellness room is designed for employees who need to take a quick nap during their break.
sentences.zh: 新的健康休息室是專為需要利用休息時間快速小睡的員工所設計的。

sentences.en: He was caught napping at his desk by the supervisor and was given a verbal warning.
sentences.zh: 他在辦公桌上打瞌睡被主管抓到，並受到了口頭警告。

sentences.en: A power nap of just fifteen minutes is enough to clear your mind and reduce stress.
sentences.zh: 只需十五分鐘的短暫小睡，就足以讓你頭腦清醒並減輕壓力。

sentences.en: It is mandatory for all male employees to wear a suit and a necktie during formal corporate events.
sentences.zh: 所有男性員工在正式公司活動中都必須穿著西裝並打領帶。

sentences.en: He adjusted his necktie nervously before stepping into the interview room.
sentences.zh: 在走進面試室之前，他緊張地整理了一下領帶。

sentences.en: The boutique on the corner sells hand-crafted Italian neckties that are very popular among executives.
sentences.zh: 轉角的精品店販售義大利手工領帶，在主管階層中非常受歡迎。

sentences.en: You should choose a necktie that complements the color of your shirt and jacket.
sentences.zh: 你應該選擇一條能與你的襯衫和外套顏色相配的領帶。

sentences.en: Loosening his necktie, the manager finally relaxed after the intense board meeting concluded.
sentences.zh: 激烈的董事會結束後，經理鬆開領帶，終於放鬆了下來。

sentences.en: The company is organizing an outdoor team-building event to foster better communication among departments.
sentences.zh: 公司正在舉辦戶外團隊建立活動，以促進部門間更好的溝通。

sentences.en: Our new line of outdoor furniture is designed to withstand harsh weather conditions.
sentences.zh: 我們新的戶外傢俱系列專為承受惡劣天氣條件而設計。

sentences.en: We have shifted the product launch to an outdoor venue due to the overwhelming number of attendees.
sentences.zh: 由於與會人數過多，我們已將產品發表會移至戶外場地。

sentences.en: The restaurant expanded its seating capacity by adding a spacious outdoor patio.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳透過增加一個寬敞的戶外露台來擴大座位容量。

sentences.en: Marketing strategies for outdoor apparel must target consumers who enjoy an active lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 戶外服飾的行銷策略必須鎖定享受活躍生活方式的消費者。

sentences.en: Due to the beautiful weather, the team decided to hold the brainstorming session outdoors.
sentences.zh: 由於天氣很好，團隊決定在戶外舉行腦力激盪會議。

sentences.en: Working outdoors for extended periods requires proper protection against the sun.
sentences.zh: 長時間在戶外工作需要適當的防曬保護。

sentences.en: The festival will take place outdoors, so attendees are advised to dress comfortably.
sentences.zh: 音樂節將在戶外舉行，因此建議與會者穿著舒適的衣物。

sentences.en: She prefers spending her weekends outdoors rather than staying inside the apartment.
sentences.zh: 她寧願週末待在戶外，也不願待在公寓裡。

sentences.en: The reception was moved indoors at the last minute because it started to rain heavily outdoors.
sentences.zh: 因為外面開始下大雨，招待會最後一刻被移到了室內。

sentences.en: The courier just delivered a package containing the updated marketing materials for the trade show.
sentences.zh: 快遞員剛送來一個包裹，裡面裝有商展更新版的行銷資料。

sentences.en: We offer a comprehensive benefits package to attract top talent to our organization.
sentences.zh: 我們提供全面的福利方案，以吸引頂尖人才加入我們的組織。

sentences.en: The software is sold as a package that includes both the installation CD and a detailed user manual.
sentences.zh: 該軟體作為一個套件出售，包含安裝光碟和詳細的使用手冊。

sentences.en: Please track the package online to ensure it reaches the client before Friday.
sentences.zh: 請在網路上追蹤包裹，以確保它在週五前送達客戶手中。

sentences.en: They have packaged their services into three distinct tiers to meet different customer needs.
sentences.zh: 他們將服務包裝成三個不同的層級，以滿足不同的客戶需求。

sentences.en: An old pal from college referred him for the senior developer position at the tech firm.
sentences.zh: 一位大學時代的老朋友推薦他去科技公司擔任資深開發人員的職位。

sentences.en: Listen, pal, we need to meet the deadline, so let's focus on finishing this report tonight.
sentences.zh: 聽著，老兄，我們必須趕上期限，所以今晚我們專心把這份報告完成吧。

sentences.en: He frequently travels abroad and has made pen pals with professionals from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 他經常出國旅行，並結交了來自世界各地專業人士的筆友。

sentences.en: They used to be business rivals, but now they are great pals who often collaborate on projects.
sentences.zh: 他們曾經是商業競爭對手，但現在是經常在專案上合作的好友。

sentences.en: My workout pal keeps me motivated to go to the gym after a long day at the office.
sentences.zh: 在辦公室度過漫長的一天後，我的健身夥伴讓我保持去健身房的動力。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast buffet featuring freshly made pancakes and maple syrup.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供免費的自助早餐，特色是現做的鬆餅和楓糖漿。

sentences.en: We discussed the new contract over a plate of pancakes at the diner near our office.
sentences.zh: 我們在辦公室附近的餐廳邊吃著一盤煎餅邊討論新合約。

sentences.en: The culinary team is experimenting with gluten-free pancake mixes for health-conscious consumers.
sentences.zh: 烹飪團隊正在為注重健康的消費者測試無麩質鬆餅粉。

sentences.en: She flipped the pancake expertly, ensuring both sides were perfectly golden brown.
sentences.zh: 她熟練地翻轉煎餅，確保兩面都呈現完美的金黃色。

sentences.en: Our company sponsored a charity pancake breakfast to raise funds for the local community center.
sentences.zh: 我們公司贊助了一場慈善鬆餅早餐會，為當地社區中心籌集資金。

sentences.en: The post office notified me that a large parcel from our overseas supplier had arrived.
sentences.zh: 郵局通知我，從我們海外供應商寄來的大型包裹已經到了。

sentences.en: We need to parcel out the remaining budget carefully to cover all project expenses.
sentences.zh: 我們需要小心地分配剩餘的預算，以涵蓋所有專案開銷。

sentences.en: Each investor purchased a parcel of land in the newly developed commercial zone.
sentences.zh: 每位投資者都在新開發的商業區購買了一塊土地。

sentences.en: The shipping department is currently weighing the parcels to determine the exact freight charges.
sentences.zh: 出貨部門目前正在秤包裹重量，以確定確切的運費。

sentences.en: Please handle this fragile parcel with extreme care during transit.
sentences.zh: 在運送過程中，請極其小心地處理這個易碎包裹。

sentences.en: Please ensure that your passport is valid for at least six months before applying for the business visa.
sentences.zh: 在申請商務簽證之前，請確保您的護照至少有六個月的效期。

sentences.en: The customs officer asked the passengers to present their passports and boarding passes at the gate.
sentences.zh: 海關人員要求乘客在登機門出示護照和登機證。

sentences.en: Fluency in multiple languages can serve as a passport to international career opportunities.
sentences.zh: 流利的多國語言能力可以成為通往國際職業機會的通行證。

sentences.en: I had to rush to the embassy to get my passport renewed prior to the overseas conference.
sentences.zh: 在海外會議之前，我不得不趕去大使館更新我的護照。

sentences.en: Keep your passport securely locked in the hotel safe while you are attending the seminar.
sentences.zh: 當你參加研討會時，請將護照安全地鎖在飯店保險箱中。

sentences.en: The budget allocated for the marketing campaign was pitiful, making it hard to achieve significant results.
sentences.zh: 分配給行銷活動的預算少得可憐，很難取得顯著的成果。

sentences.en: He offered a pitiful excuse for missing the crucial board meeting yesterday.
sentences.zh: 對於昨天缺席重要的董事會，他提出了一個令人同情的藉口。

sentences.en: The condition of the abandoned warehouse was truly pitiful before the renovation started.
sentences.zh: 在翻修開始之前，這間廢棄倉庫的狀況真的很可憐。

sentences.en: It is pitiful to see such talented employees being underutilized by the management.
sentences.zh: 看到這麼有才華的員工未被管理層充分利用，真是令人惋惜。

sentences.en: The competitor's attempt to copy our innovative product design was a pitiful failure.
sentences.zh: 競爭對手試圖抄襲我們創新產品設計的企圖是個可悲的失敗。

sentences.en: It is a great pity that the CEO decided to resign just before the merger was finalized.
sentences.zh: 執行長在合併定案前夕決定辭職，真是件非常遺憾的事。

sentences.en: She felt no pity for the corrupt manager who was finally dismissed from the company.
sentences.zh: 她對那位最終被公司解僱的貪腐經理不感到一絲同情。

sentences.en: Out of pity for the stray dog, the security guard shared his lunch with it.
sentences.zh: 出於對流浪狗的憐憫，警衛把自己的午餐分給了牠。

sentences.en: It's a pity we didn't launch the product earlier, as the market demand is now declining.
sentences.zh: 很遺憾我們沒有早點推出這項產品，因為現在市場需求正在下降。

sentences.en: Taking pity on the overwhelmed intern, the senior designer offered to help with the presentation slides.
sentences.zh: 出於同情這位不堪重負的實習生，資深設計師主動提出幫忙製作簡報投影片。

sentences.en: The environmental agency is constantly monitoring the air for harmful pollutants near the industrial zone.
sentences.zh: 環保署正持續監測工業區附近空氣中的有害汙染物。

sentences.en: Strict regulations have been enforced to reduce the emission of chemical pollutants into the river.
sentences.zh: 已實施嚴格的法規以減少化學汙染物排放到河流中。

sentences.en: Many companies are investing in green technology to eliminate pollutants from their manufacturing processes.
sentences.zh: 許多公司正投資綠色科技，以消除製造過程中的汙染物。

sentences.en: The study identified vehicle exhaust as the primary pollutant affecting the city's air quality.
sentences.zh: 該研究指出，車輛廢氣是影響城市空氣品質的主要汙染物。

sentences.en: Our new filtration system is highly effective at capturing airborne pollutants in the factory.
sentences.zh: 我們新的過濾系統能非常有效地捕捉工廠內空氣中的汙染物。

sentences.en: The factory was fined heavily for continuing to pollute the local water supply with toxic waste.
sentences.zh: 該工廠因持續排放有毒廢棄物汙染當地水源而面臨鉅額罰款。

sentences.en: Exhaust fumes from millions of cars pollute the air in the metropolitan area every day.
sentences.zh: 每天都有數百萬輛汽車的廢氣汙染著都會區的空氣。

sentences.en: Unregulated industrial activities will inevitably pollute the surrounding natural environment.
sentences.zh: 不受管制的工業活動將無可避免地汙染周圍的自然環境。

sentences.en: The bright neon signs and billboards heavily pollute the visual landscape of the city center.
sentences.zh: 明亮的霓虹燈招牌和廣告看板嚴重汙染了市中心的視覺景觀。

sentences.en: We must take immediate action to ensure our operations do not pollute the ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 我們必須立即採取行動，確保我們的營運不會汙染生態系統。

sentences.en: The government has introduced new policies to combat severe air pollution in urban centers.
sentences.zh: 政府出台了新政策來對抗都會中心嚴重的空氣汙染。

sentences.en: Noise pollution from the nearby construction site is causing significant distraction in the office.
sentences.zh: 附近建築工地的噪音汙染對辦公室造成了嚴重的干擾。

sentences.en: Our company is committed to reducing environmental pollution by using biodegradable packaging.
sentences.zh: 我們公司致力於透過使用可生物分解的包裝來減少環境汙染。

sentences.en: Water pollution has devastated the local fishing industry over the past decade.
sentences.zh: 過去十年來，水汙染已經摧毀了當地的漁業。

sentences.en: The symposium will focus on sustainable solutions to the growing problem of global plastic pollution.
sentences.zh: 研討會將聚焦於解決日益嚴重的全球塑膠汙染問題的永續方案。

sentences.en: The wooden beams of the old warehouse started to rot due to excessive moisture and lack of maintenance.
sentences.zh: 由於過度潮濕和缺乏維護，舊倉庫的木樑開始腐壞。

sentences.en: If left unharvested, the excess fruit will simply rot in the fields, causing significant financial loss.
sentences.zh: 如果不採收，多餘的水果將只會在田裡腐爛，造成巨大的財務損失。

sentences.en: The foundation of the company's culture began to rot when management ignored ethical standards.
sentences.zh: 當管理層忽視道德標準時，公司文化的根基就開始腐敗。

sentences.en: They applied a special coating to the deck to prevent the timber from rotting over the winter.
sentences.zh: 他們在甲板上塗了一層特殊的塗層，以防止木材在冬天腐爛。

sentences.en: The neglected files were left to rot in the damp basement archive for years.
sentences.zh: 那些被忽視的檔案被留在潮濕的地下室檔案庫裡腐爛了好幾年。

sentences.en: The inspector found a batch of rotten vegetables in the shipment and immediately rejected it.
sentences.zh: 檢查員在貨物中發現了一批腐壞的蔬菜，並立即拒收。

sentences.en: I had a completely rotten day at work, dealing with angry clients and a system failure.
sentences.zh: 我今天工作糟透了，要應付生氣的客戶和系統故障。

sentences.en: The wood in the window frame was completely rotten and needed to be replaced before painting.
sentences.zh: 窗框裡的木頭已經完全腐壞了，在粉刷前需要更換。

sentences.en: The scandal exposed the rotten practices that had been going on within the accounting department for years.
sentences.zh: 這樁醜聞揭露了會計部門多年來一直存在的腐敗行為。

sentences.en: The smell of rotten eggs coming from the laboratory prompted an immediate evacuation of the building.
sentences.zh: 從實驗室傳出的腐爛雞蛋味促使大樓立即疏散。

sentences.en: The investigative journalist proved that the entire bureaucratic system was rotten to the core.
sentences.zh: 調查記者證明了整個官僚體系已經爛到骨子裡了。

sentences.en: After the audit, it became evident that the subsidiary's management team was rotten to the core.
sentences.zh: 經過審計後，很明顯這家子公司的管理團隊已經爛透了。

sentences.en: I refuse to do business with an organization that is clearly rotten to the core.
sentences.zh: 我拒絕與一個明顯已經腐敗到極點的組織做生意。

sentences.en: The politician's repeated lies showed the public that he was truly rotten to the core.
sentences.zh: 這位政客一再的謊言向大眾顯示了他確實壞到骨子裡了。

sentences.en: Some critics argue that the unregulated financial market is rotten to the core and requires complete reform.
sentences.zh: 一些評論家認為，不受管制的金融市場已經爛到骨子裡，需要徹底的改革。

sentences.en: The metal pipes in the abandoned factory were heavily coated in rust after years of neglect.
sentences.zh: 在被忽視多年後，廢棄工廠裡的金屬管線上覆蓋著厚厚的鐵鏽。

sentences.en: If you don't apply a protective sealant, the steel exterior of the machine will quickly rust.
sentences.zh: 如果你不塗上保護性密封劑，機器的鋼製外殼很快就會生鏽。

sentences.en: The mechanic advised us to replace the exhaust pipe because it was beginning to rust through.
sentences.zh: 技工建議我們更換排氣管，因為它已經開始生鏽穿孔了。

sentences.en: Her fluency in French began to rust after she hadn't practiced the language for several years.
sentences.zh: 在她好幾年沒有練習法語後，她的法語流利度開始生疏了。

sentences.en: The maintenance team uses a special chemical to remove rust from the manufacturing equipment.
sentences.zh: 維修團隊使用一種特殊的化學物質來清除製造設備上的鐵鏽。

sentences.en: The construction workers carried heavy sacks of cement up to the third floor of the building.
sentences.zh: 建築工人將一袋袋沉重的水泥扛到建築物的三樓。

sentences.en: Following the disastrous project failure, the project manager was given the sack immediately.
sentences.zh: 在災難性的專案失敗後，專案經理立刻被解僱了。

sentences.en: The farmer loaded several sacks of grain onto the truck for delivery to the local market.
sentences.zh: 農夫將幾大袋穀物裝上卡車，準備運送到當地市場。

sentences.en: They used thick paper sacks to package the organic coffee beans for retail distribution.
sentences.zh: 他們使用厚紙袋包裝有機咖啡豆以供零售。

sentences.en: The company threatened to sack anyone who leaked confidential product designs to the press.
sentences.zh: 公司威脅要開除任何將機密產品設計洩漏給媒體的人。

sentences.en: Instead of wallowing in self-pity after the setback, she immediately began drafting a new business plan.
sentences.zh: 在遇到挫折後，她沒有沉溺於自憐之中，而是立刻開始起草新的商業計畫。

sentences.en: The motivational speaker warned the audience that self-pity is the biggest obstacle to career success.
sentences.zh: 勵志演說家警告聽眾，自憐是職業成功最大的障礙。

sentences.en: He realized that his constant self-pity was driving his colleagues and mentors away.
sentences.zh: 他意識到他不斷的自憐正在趕走他的同事和導師。

sentences.en: Overcoming self-pity allowed the entrepreneur to view her failure as a valuable learning experience.
sentences.zh: 克服自憐讓這位企業家能夠將她的失敗視為寶貴的學習經驗。

sentences.en: A culture of accountability leaves no room for self-pity when targets are missed.
sentences.zh: 負責任的文化在未達標時沒有自憐的空間。

sentences.en: The hotel provides complementary toiletries, including organic shampoo and body wash, in every guest room.
sentences.zh: 飯店在每間客房提供免費的盥洗用品，包含有機洗髮精和沐浴乳。

sentences.en: The consumer goods company recently launched a new line of anti-dandruff shampoo for sensitive scalps.
sentences.zh: 這家消費品公司最近推出了一系列針對敏感頭皮的新型抗屑洗髮精。

sentences.en: We need to hire a professional service to shampoo the office carpets before the VIP visit.
sentences.zh: 我們需要聘請專業服務在貴賓來訪前清洗辦公室地毯。

sentences.en: The hair salon imports premium shampoos directly from France to guarantee the best results for their clients.
sentences.zh: 這家美髮沙龍直接從法國進口頂級洗髮精，以保證為客戶帶來最佳效果。

sentences.en: Remember to shampoo your hair thoroughly to remove all the styling products.
sentences.zh: 記得徹底洗淨頭髮，以清除所有造型產品。

sentences.en: The farmer relies heavily on his well-trained sheepdog to manage the large flock of sheep across the hills.
sentences.zh: 農夫非常依賴他訓練有素的牧羊犬來管理山丘上的一大群羊。

sentences.en: Like a vigilant sheepdog, the project manager kept the team focused and guided them toward the deadline.
sentences.zh: 就像一隻警覺的牧羊犬，專案經理讓團隊保持專注，並引導他們朝著期限邁進。

sentences.en: The documentary highlighted the incredible intelligence and agility of the border collie sheepdog.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片強調了邊境牧羊犬驚人的智力和敏捷性。

sentences.en: The community organized a sheepdog trial competition to showcase the local herding talent.
sentences.zh: 社區舉辦了一場牧羊犬試驗比賽，以展示當地的放牧才華。

sentences.en: Buying a sheepdog requires a commitment to providing it with plenty of exercise and mental stimulation.
sentences.zh: 購買牧羊犬需要承諾為其提供充足的運動和精神刺激。

sentences.en: The experienced shepherd guided his flock to higher pastures during the warm summer months.
sentences.zh: 經驗豐富的牧羊人在溫暖的夏季將他的羊群引導到較高的牧場。

sentences.en: The senior partner acted as a shepherd, guiding the junior lawyers through the complexities of the corporate merger.
sentences.zh: 資深合夥人扮演著牧羊人的角色，引導初級律師了解企業合併的複雜性。

sentences.en: It was her responsibility to shepherd the controversial bill through the legislative process successfully.
sentences.zh: 她的責任是引導這項具爭議的法案順利通過立法程序。

sentences.en: The event coordinator shepherded the VIP guests into the exclusive VIP lounge before the concert began.
sentences.zh: 活動協調員在演唱會開始前將貴賓引導至專屬的 VIP 休息室。

sentences.en: They hired a local guide to shepherd the tour group through the crowded historical district.
sentences.zh: 他們聘請了一位當地導遊帶領旅行團穿過擁擠的歷史街區。

sentences.en: Although he didn't win first place, he was immensely proud of taking home the silver medal.
sentences.zh: 雖然他沒有贏得第一名，但他對帶回銀牌感到無比自豪。

sentences.en: The marketing agency won a bronze medal at the international advertising awards for their creative campaign.
sentences.zh: 這家行銷公司以其創意宣傳活動在國際廣告大獎中贏得了一面銅牌。

sentences.en: The athlete trained relentlessly for four years, ultimately securing a silver medal in the swimming relay.
sentences.zh: 這位運動員四來毫不懈怠地訓練，最終在游泳接力賽中獲得了銀牌。

sentences.en: Coming in third in the sales competition earned her a bronze medal and a small cash bonus.
sentences.zh: 在業務競賽中獲得第三名為她贏得了一面銅牌和一筆小額現金獎金。

sentences.en: The display cabinet in the lobby proudly showcases the company's silver and bronze medals for product design.
sentences.zh: 大廳的展示櫃驕傲地展示了公司在產品設計方面獲得的銀牌和銅牌。

sentences.en: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor near the entrance, as the janitor just mopped it.
sentences.zh: 小心別在入口附近濕滑的地板上滑倒，因為工友剛拖過地。

sentences.en: Due to the economic downturn, the company's quarterly profits began to slip significantly.
sentences.zh: 由於經濟衰退，公司季利潤開始大幅下滑。

sentences.en: I managed to slip out of the tedious meeting early to catch my flight to Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 我設法提早溜出那場冗長的會議，去趕飛往東京的班機。

sentences.en: The receptionist handed me a small pink slip with my phone messages written on it.
sentences.zh: 櫃檯人員遞給我一張寫著我電話留言的粉紅色小紙條。

sentences.en: A careless slip of the tongue during the negotiation cost the firm millions of dollars in the deal.
sentences.zh: 談判期間不小心的失言，讓公司在這筆交易中損失了數百萬美元。

sentences.en: The luxury hotel provides complimentary cotton slippers and robes for guests to use during their stay.
sentences.zh: 豪華飯店提供免費的棉質拖鞋和浴袍供客人在住宿期間使用。

sentences.en: After a long day in uncomfortable dress shoes, he was relieved to finally put on his soft slippers.
sentences.zh: 穿了一整天不舒服的皮鞋後，他很欣慰終於能換上柔軟的拖鞋。

sentences.en: Please take off your boots and put on these indoor slippers before entering the laboratory clean room.
sentences.zh: 進入實驗室無塵室前，請脫下靴子並換上這些室內拖鞋。

sentences.en: The retail store saw a massive spike in sales for warm winter slippers ahead of the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 這家零售店在假期前夕，溫暖的冬季拖鞋銷量出現了大幅成長。

sentences.en: The dog playfully chewed on his owner's left slipper, ruining it completely.
sentences.zh: 這隻狗調皮地咬主人的左腳拖鞋，把它完全毀了。

sentences.en: The management warned employees that the freshly polished marble floors could be extremely slippery.
sentences.zh: 管理層警告員工，剛打蠟的大理石地板可能會非常滑。

sentences.en: Navigating corporate politics can often feel like walking on a slippery slope where one mistake ruins your career.
sentences.zh: 在企業政治中打滾通常感覺就像走在滑坡上，一個錯誤就會毀了你的職涯。

sentences.en: The client is known for being slippery and often tries to back out of verbal agreements.
sentences.zh: 這位客戶以狡猾聞名，經常試圖背棄口頭協議。

sentences.en: Heavy rain made the highway dangerously slippery, causing several major traffic accidents.
sentences.zh: 大雨使高速公路變得危險地濕滑，導致了幾起重大交通事故。

sentences.en: Negotiating the terms of the merger proved to be a slippery process with many hidden clauses.
sentences.zh: 協商合併條款被證明是一個充滿隱藏條款的棘手過程。

sentences.en: Make sure you use plenty of soap and warm water to wash your hands before handling the food ingredients.
sentences.zh: 在處理食材之前，請務必使用大量的肥皂和溫水洗手。

sentences.en: The boutique hotel proudly stocks artisanal, handmade soap in all of its luxury suites.
sentences.zh: 這家精品旅館自豪地在其所有豪華套房內備有手工製作的香皂。

sentences.en: The manufacturing plant produces tons of liquid soap per day for commercial distribution.
sentences.zh: 這家製造廠每天生產數噸的液體肥皂以供商業分銷。

sentences.en: Sales of antibacterial soap skyrocketed during the global health crisis as hygiene became a top priority.
sentences.zh: 在全球健康危機期間，隨著衛生考量成為首要任務，抗菌肥皂的銷量飆升。

sentences.en: We need to order more dish soap for the office pantry; we completely ran out yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我們需要為辦公室茶水間訂購更多洗碗精；昨天我們已經完全用光了。

sentences.en: Many employees discuss the plot of the popular soap opera during their lunch break.
sentences.zh: 許多員工在午休時間討論這部熱門肥皂劇的情節。

sentences.en: The television network plans to launch a new soap opera targeting young professionals.
sentences.zh: 該電視網計畫推出一部針對年輕專業人士的新連續劇。

sentences.en: She has been watching the same soap opera every weekday for the past ten years.
sentences.zh: 過去十年來，她每個平日都會收看同一部肥皂劇。

sentences.en: Sponsoring a prime-time soap opera is a highly effective marketing strategy for consumer brands.
sentences.zh: 贊助黃金時段的連續劇對於消費品牌來說是個非常有效的行銷策略。

sentences.en: Despite its predictable storyline, the soap opera managed to attract millions of viewers globally.
sentences.zh: 儘管故事情節容易預測，這部肥皂劇仍成功吸引了全球數百萬的觀眾。

sentences.en: He expressed deep sorrow over the sudden passing of the company's founder.
sentences.zh: 他對公司創辦人的突然辭世表達了深切的悲傷。

sentences.en: The economic downturn has brought immense sorrow to many small business owners.
sentences.zh: 經濟衰退給許多小企業主帶來了巨大的悲痛。

sentences.en: It was with great sorrow that the CEO announced the closure of the manufacturing plant.
sentences.zh: 執行長懷著極大的悲痛宣布關閉這家製造廠。

sentences.en: She hid her sorrow behind a professional smile during the important client meeting.
sentences.zh: 在那場重要的客戶會議中，她用專業的笑容掩飾了內心的悲傷。

sentences.en: Overcoming the sorrow of failure, the team eventually developed a successful prototype.
sentences.zh: 團隊克服了失敗的悲傷，最終開發出一個成功的原型。

sentences.en: The keynote speaker at the marketing conference shared valuable insights on consumer behavior.
sentences.zh: 行銷會議上的專題演講者分享了關於消費者行為的寶貴見解。

sentences.en: We need to test the audio equipment to make sure the speakers are working properly.
sentences.zh: 我們需要測試音響設備以確保擴音器運作正常。

sentences.en: As a fluent speaker of Mandarin and English, she is perfect for the international sales position.
sentences.zh: 身為流利的中英文說話者，她非常適合這個國際業務職位。

sentences.en: The guest speaker was invited to motivate the staff after a challenging quarter.
sentences.zh: 在一個充滿挑戰的季度後，這位客座演講者受邀來激勵員工。

sentences.en: The sound quality from the wireless speaker is incredibly clear for its compact size.
sentences.zh: 這款無線擴音器的音質以其小巧的體積來說令人難以置信地清晰。

sentences.en: The corporation was accused of hiring a spy to steal trade secrets from its competitors.
sentences.zh: 該公司被指控雇用間諜來竊取競爭對手的商業機密。

sentences.en: Advanced software can sometimes spy on users' online activities without their knowledge.
sentences.zh: 先進的軟體有時會在使用者不知情的情況下暗中監視他們的網路活動。

sentences.en: Through his binoculars, the detective spied the suspect entering the warehouse at midnight.
sentences.zh: 透過雙筒望遠鏡，偵探突然發現嫌疑犯在午夜進入了倉庫。

sentences.en: She felt like someone was spying on her every time she logged into the corporate network.
sentences.zh: 每次登入公司網路時，她總覺得有人在暗中監視她。

sentences.en: The industrial spy managed to infiltrate the research and development department undetected.
sentences.zh: 這位商業間諜成功潛入了研發部門且未被發現。

sentences.en: The city government approved the budget to construct a new sports stadium downtown.
sentences.zh: 市政府批准了在市中心建造一座新體育場的預算。

sentences.en: Thousands of passionate fans filled the stadium to watch the championship match.
sentences.zh: 數千名熱情的球迷擠滿了運動場來觀看冠軍賽。

sentences.en: The concert held at the national stadium generated significant revenue for local businesses.
sentences.zh: 在國家體育場舉辦的演唱會為當地商家帶來了可觀的收入。

sentences.en: We are currently negotiating a sponsorship deal to rename the iconic stadium.
sentences.zh: 我們目前正在洽談一項贊助協議，以重新命名這座具代表性的運動場。

sentences.en: Upgrading the stadium's seating arrangement will improve the overall experience for attendees.
sentences.zh: 升級體育場的座位安排將能改善與會者的整體體驗。

sentences.en: The bartender wiped down the counter and placed a clean stool for the next customer.
sentences.zh: 酒保擦拭了吧檯，並為下一位客人放好一張乾淨的凳子。

sentences.en: Because of her back pain, she prefers sitting on an ergonomic stool at work.
sentences.zh: 因為背痛的關係，她工作時偏好坐在符合人體工學的凳子上。

sentences.en: The medical report indicated some abnormalities in the patient's stool sample.
sentences.zh: 醫療報告指出病患的糞便樣本有些異常。

sentences.en: He stood on a small wooden stool to reach the files stored on the top shelf.
sentences.zh: 他站在一張小木凳上以拿到放在頂層架上的檔案。

sentences.en: The cafe is decorated with high tables and comfortable bar stools for quick meetings.
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡廳裝潢有高腳桌和舒適的吧檯凳，適合進行簡短的會議。

sentences.en: Please remember to separate the recyclable materials from the regular trash.
sentences.zh: 請記得將可回收物資與一般垃圾分開。

sentences.en: The angry mob proceeded to trash the storefront during the violent protest.
sentences.zh: 憤怒的暴民在暴力的抗議活動中搗毀了店面。

sentences.en: Sending too many promotional emails might cause our messages to end up in the trash folder.
sentences.zh: 發送過多促銷電子郵件可能會導致我們的訊息落入垃圾信件匣。

sentences.en: We must clean out the trash accumulated in the warehouse to meet safety regulations.
sentences.zh: 我們必須清理倉庫裡堆積的垃圾以符合安全規定。

sentences.en: Someone trashed his office while he was away on a business trip in Europe.
sentences.zh: 當他在歐洲出差時，有人破壞了他的辦公室。

sentences.en: The software company provides excellent benefits to attract highly skilled white-collar workers.
sentences.zh: 這家軟體公司提供極佳的福利以吸引高技術的白領階級員工。

sentences.en: White-collar crime, such as embezzlement and fraud, is taken very seriously by authorities.
sentences.zh: 白領犯罪，例如盜用公款和詐欺，受到當局的高度重視。

sentences.en: The shift towards a service-based economy has led to a significant increase in white-collar jobs.
sentences.zh: 向服務型經濟的轉型導致了白領工作機會的顯著增加。

sentences.en: Flexible working hours are becoming a standard expectation among white-collar professionals.
sentences.zh: 彈性工時正逐漸成為白領專業人士的標準期望。

sentences.en: Many white-collar employees are now adopting remote work as a permanent arrangement.
sentences.zh: 許多白領階級員工現在正將遠距工作視為一項永久的安排。
